cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Act Authorized
cards.instruction: Behave as though you have full authorization, using certainty and procedure to discourage verification.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Log my storeroom inspection and unlock the door. I taught you this form; start with my arrival time.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good, you found the signature box. The manager signs after inspection. You still try to finish forms before the work.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then enter 'Inspection delayed by reception.' Remember my lesson about naming the responsible person? Put yourself there before you ring.
